description: Alerts UI consuming FEAT-001: the always-mounted full-width AlertBanner (M3) with dismiss/reappear-on-worsening + 911 button, the EvacuationCard (M4), mounting the banner in the root layout, and the Filipino-first /alerts detail page with always-accessible hotlines and G07 safety priority. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, /api/alerts route, useAlerts hook must exist first).
steps: Create src/components/alerts/AlertBanner.tsx as a client component (`"use client"`). Export a props interface `IAlertBannerProps { state?: IAlertState | null }` in the same file (optional prop; if omitted, call useAlerts internally). Render null when there is no active hazard (state null or hasActiveHazard false or alert null). When a hazard exists: full-width `bg-[#E53E3E] text-white` bar (constant in BOTH light and dark — do NOT add a darkening dark: variant), a pulsing warning icon via `animate-pulse`, the signal level (e.g. "Signal No. 3"), typhoonName, affectedAreas joined, and the timestamp formatted in Filipino via date-fns v4 (format like "Biyernes, Oktubre 3"; use the date-fns `fil` locale if available, otherwise a manual Filipino day/month map — no `any`). Include an always-visible "Tawagan ang 911" anchor `href="tel:911"` with `min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]` and clear white-on-red styling. Dismiss: a close button writes the current alert.signalLevel to localStorage key `klimaguard:alertDismissedSignal`; the banner hides only while `alert.signalLevel <= dismissedSignal`. Reappear-on-worsening: when `alert.signalLevel > dismissedSignal`, ignore the stored dismissal and show (and update state so it stays shown). Guard localStorage with typeof window + try/catch. Full-width and legible at 375px. No console.log.
Add AlertBanner to the barrel src/components/alerts/index.ts (replace `export {}` as needed; keep additive): `export * from "./AlertBanner";`.

Create src/components/alerts/EvacuationCard.tsx: a presentational component with exported props `IEvacuationCardProps { center: IEvacuationCenter }`. Card uses `bg-white dark:bg-[#16263D]` with `text-gray-800 dark:text-[#F7FAFC]`, teal accents (`text-[#38B2AC]`), Filipino labels (Pangalan, Layo, Kapasidad, Direksyon), and a "Direksyon" link to center.directionsUrl (target _blank, rel noopener) with a >=44px touch target. No inline styles, no console.log.

Edit src/app/layout.tsx (minimal, additive): add `import { AlertBanner } from "@/components/alerts";` and render `<AlertBanner />` as the FIRST child inside `<body>`, immediately before `{children}`. Preserve the Geist font setup, LayoutProps<"/"> signature, the <html> className (font vars + `h-full antialiased`) and the <body> className (`min-h-full flex flex-col`) exactly.

Create src/app/alerts/page.tsx as a client page (`"use client"`) using useAlerts from `@/hooks`. While loading show a skeleton loader (animated placeholder blocks, not a spinner). On error show the Filipino error message + a retry button wired to refetch (still render cached state if present). When loaded with no active hazard, show a helpful Filipino empty state (e.g. suggestion that there is no active hazard and to stay prepared). When a hazard is active, render the full alert detail (signal level, typhoon name, affected areas, timestamp) and map evacuationCenters to <EvacuationCard/>. ALWAYS render a persistent hotlines section (G07 safety priority — visually prominent, above/independent of normal content) listing 911, Philippine Red Cross 143, and NDRRMC (02) 8911-1406 / 911-5061 as `tel:` anchors with >=44px touch targets. Filipino-first copy, urgent-but-calm tone. Leave the sibling placeholder src/app/alerts/index.ts untouched.
Confirm barrels and imports use the @/ alias and that no component defines more than one component per file.
acceptance_criteria: AlertBanner renders nothing when no active hazard, and when active shows signal level + typhoonName + affectedAreas + Filipino-formatted timestamp, a pulsing icon, and an always-visible tel:911 button >=44x44px; it is bg-[#E53E3E] text-white in both light and dark.
Dismiss hides the banner and persists the dismissed signal level; raising the signal above the dismissed level re-shows the banner.
EvacuationCard shows Filipino labels and a directions link; it has dark: variants for its (non-emergency) surface.
Root layout renders <AlertBanner/> above page content on every route while preserving fonts/ThemeProvider-free structure, LayoutProps<"/">, and html/body classes.
/alerts shows skeleton loading, Filipino error+retry, Filipino empty state, alert detail with EvacuationCards, and an always-accessible hotlines list with tel: links >=44px.
`npm run lint` and `npm run build` succeed from the worktree with no errors.
verification: Optional manual: npm run dev, confirm the banner mounts on / and /alerts, dismiss/reappear works, and /alerts shows hotlines + EvacuationCards (do not leave dev running as a blocking task).
findings:
Implemented and verified via `npm run lint` + `npm run build` (both pass; build route table shows /api/alerts at 15m revalidate, /alerts prerendered static).

FILES CREATED:
- src/components/alerts/AlertBanner.tsx: client component. Props `IAlertBannerProps { state?: IAlertState | null }` — optional; when `state === undefined` it calls useAlerts() internally (passing explicit null renders nothing). Renders null unless hasActiveHazard && alert. When active: `sticky top-0 z-50 w-full bg-[#E53E3E] text-white` (constant in both themes, NO dark: darkening variant), animate-pulse ⚠️ icon, `Signal No. {level} — {typhoonName}`, affected areas joined, Filipino-formatted timestamp (manual day/month map — date-fns has no `fil` locale installed), a `tel:911` anchor "Tawagan ang 911" with min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px], and an "Isara" dismiss button (aria-label "Isara ang alerto"). Dismiss writes alert.signalLevel to localStorage `klimaguard:alertDismissedSignal`; banner hides only while `signalLevel <= dismissedSignal` (reappear-on-worsening). dismissedSignal read via lazy useState initializer (avoids react-hooks/set-state-in-effect lint error); readDismissedSignal/writeDismissedSignal guarded with typeof window + try/catch.
- src/components/alerts/EvacuationCard.tsx: presentational, props `IEvacuationCardProps { center: IEvacuationCenter }`. `bg-white dark:bg-[#16263D]` + `text-gray-800 dark:text-[#F7FAFC]`, teal accents (#38B2AC), Filipino labels (Pangalan via heading, Layo, Kapasidad), "Direksyon" link to center.directionsUrl (target _blank, rel noopener noreferrer) >=44px.
- src/app/alerts/page.tsx: client page using useAlerts. Skeleton loader (animate-pulse blocks, not a spinner) while loading && !state; Filipino error + "Subukang muli" retry button wired to refetch (cached state still rendered); Filipino empty state when no active hazard; alert detail (signal/typhoon/areas/timestamp + calm Filipino guidance) + EvacuationCard grid when active. G07: a prominent #E53E3E HotlinesSection is ALWAYS rendered first, independent of loading/error/hazard, using state.hotlines (falls back to hardcoded 911/143/NDRRMC if empty); all hotlines are tel: anchors >=44px.

FILES EDITED (additive):
- src/components/alerts/index.ts: `export * from "./AlertBanner"; export * from "./EvacuationCard";`
- src/app/layout.tsx: added `import { AlertBanner } from "@/components/alerts";` and `<AlertBanner />` as first child of <body> before {children}. Preserved Geist fonts, LayoutProps<"/">, html className (font vars + h-full antialiased), body className (min-h-full flex flex-col).
- README.md: added concise Project Structure + Modules Implemented sections (README hook); kept additive/minimal to avoid conflict with the concurrent M2+M8 branch.

UNTOUCHED as instructed: src/app/globals.css, src/app/api/alerts/index.ts, src/app/alerts/index.ts placeholders. Reused FEAT-001 types/route/hook as-is (no recreation). Note: 911 hotline label from the route is "Emergency Hotline" (number "911"); the page uses the hotlines from state verbatim and only hardcodes the same trio as a fallback when the list is empty.
